ITEM.PTXT: G-BOOK.com is a user's own menu folder in which convenient preset contents can be viewed and executed, and which can be customized by adding G-BOOK's extensive contents to create the user's own G-BOOK.
The G-BOOK.com screen is displayed by touching "G-BOOK.com" on the main menu screen; touching the touch switch frame of each menu displayed there moves to that menu.
